overview: Pointe-Claire had 33,488 residents in the 2021 Census, up 6.7 percent from 31,380 in 2016, living in 13,313 occupied dwellings on 18.91 square kilometres. It is a compact city on the shore of Lac Saint-Louis.

Pointe-Claire is a larger retail and employment centre than its size suggests, with the West Island's largest mall, eleven shopping centres and an industrial park hosting pharmaceutical and technology firms. Local businesses compete with national chains for shoppers who come from across the West Island, as well as for nearby residents.
